scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Just one second.
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you better
place some of your things
into Kafra Storage, yes?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请稍等。
您身上携带的物品太多了，
最好把一些东西存进卡普拉仓库，
您说呢？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Excuse me, monsieur?
Yes, you. If you're not
here as hired help for the
kitchen, then I'd like to
ask you to leave now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
打扰一下，先生？
对，就是你。如果你不是来厨房
做帮工的，那我建议你立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please don't be
offended, but I can't
concentrate on my 
cooking when Novices
like yourself are running
around here like children.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请别介意，但像你这样的初心者
在这里像孩子一样跑来跑去，
让我无法专心烹饪。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mademoiselle, what
are you doing in this
area of the castle?
Oh, you must be lost~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
小姐，您在这座城堡的
这个区域做什么呢？
哦，您一定是迷路了~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please, use the stairs
to the right to exit into the
main structure. My dear,
be careful and watch your
step when you climb up
the stairs for me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请走右边的楼梯
到主楼去。亲爱的，
爬楼梯的时候请小心脚下，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Monsieur, why you look
at me so? Is it the Morocc
silk shirt I am wearing, my
hair styled by Madam Veronica,
or my brand name muffler
refined by Monsieur Antonio?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
先生，您为什么这样看着我？
是因为我穿着摩洛哥丝绸衬衫，
还是因为维罗妮卡女士为我打理的发型，
亦或是安东尼奥先生为我挑选的名牌围巾？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Perhaps you are in awe
of the latest, fashionable
spectacles that was designed
by the artists from the Rekenber Corporation? Please, do tell~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
也许您是被雷肯贝尔公司
设计师设计的最新时尚眼镜
所折服了？请告诉我~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait just a
moment. Do you know
anything about the latest
trends? You don't seem
to be very fashionable...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
等等，请稍等。
您了解最新的潮流吗？
您看起来似乎不太时尚...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ugh, if I can avoid it,
I usually prefer not to
associate with ruffians.
But I do find that you
adventurers do have
your strong points...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
唉，如果可以的话，
我通常不喜欢和粗鲁的人打交道。
但我发现你们冒险者
确实有你们独特的优点...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh! Pardon the squalor
of my humble kitchen,
Mademoiselle. But even
the splendor of the Prontera
Castle pales to the radiance
of your captivating beauty.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦！请原谅我这简陋厨房的
杂乱无章，小姐。但即使是普隆德拉
城堡的辉煌，在您迷人的美貌
面前也显得黯然失色。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Tell me, who is the
lovely child holding
the cat right next to you?
I know it is rude to ask,
but I am emboldened by
my, shall we say, curiosity.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
告诉我，您旁边那个
抱着猫的可爱孩子是谁？
我知道这样问很失礼，
但我被一种，姑且称之为好奇心
的东西驱使着。

scripts.text: She is my sister
scripts.translation: 她是我的妹妹

scripts.text: Actually, I don't know her.
scripts.translation: 其实，我不认识她。

scripts.text:
[The kid with a cat]
Nyahahaha,
Nyahahaha~
Meow~ Meow~
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
呀哈哈哈，
呀哈哈哈~
喵~ 喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What a lovely child.
Be quiet like a good girl.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
真是个可爱的孩子。
乖一点，安静些。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...Nya?
...Meow?
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
...喵？
...喵？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
She is lovely and
quite although she
doesn't look like you.
Even her cat looks adorable.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
她既可爱又安静，
虽然看起来不像您。
连她的猫看起来都很可爱。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha,
Nyahahaha~
Meow, meow~
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
呀哈哈哈，
呀哈哈哈~
喵，喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, again, let me
apologize. I had believed
that this child was fortunate
enough to be a companion
of the mademoiselle.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，再次向您致歉。
我原以为这个孩子很幸运，
能成为小姐的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Allow me to introduce
myself to you, amour.
I am your ever faithful
servant whose heart is
enraptured by your gaze.
My name is Charles Orleans.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请允许我向您介绍自己，亲爱的。
我是您永远忠诚的仆人，
我的心早已为您的目光所倾倒。
我的名字是查尔斯·奥尔良。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Yet there is one thing that
anguishes me. Ever since his
highness, King Tristram III,
has vanished, I have found no
one worthy of tasting my wares.
My life now lacks meaning...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
然而有一件事让我痛苦不已。
自从特里斯坦三世陛下失踪后，
我就再也没找到配得上品尝我佳肴的人了。
我的生活如今失去了意义...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Alas, recently I have been
reduced to teaching mere
apprentices, tyros in the
culinary arts, my skills.
It is frustrating--many of
them do not have any talent!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
唉，最近我不得不
教一些毫无天赋的学徒，
这些烹饪艺术的初学者。
这真让人沮丧——
他们中很多人完全没有天赋！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, forgive me, dear
Mademoiselle. I hope you
understand the difficulty
I am forced to suffer. When
next we meet, I would very much like to give you a sweet dessert.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，请原谅我，
可爱的小姐。希望您能理解
我被迫忍受的困境。
下次见面时，我非常想
为您准备一份甜蜜的甜点。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Yes, women with your
beauty definitely deserve
the luscious flavors of the
treats that only I can offer.
Until that day comes, I shall
reluctantly bid you adieu.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
是的，拥有您这般美貌的女性，
绝对值得品尝只有我能提供的
美味佳肴。在那天到来之前，
我不得不依依不舍地向您告辞。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, have you come here
to learn cooking? ^333333*Sigh*^000000
I don't feel like teaching
anything today--in fact,
I think teaching is a waste
of my time! ^333333*Sigh*^000000 However...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，你是来学烹饪的吗？^333333*叹气*^000000
我今天不想教任何东西——
事实上，我觉得教学是浪费时间！^333333*叹气*^000000 不过...

scripts.text: Um, are you talking to me?
scripts.translation: 呃，你在跟我说话吗？

scripts.text: Wait, don't you remember me?
scripts.translation: 等等，你不记得我了吗？

scripts.text: Sir Orleans?
scripts.translation: 奥尔良先生？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Who else would
I be talking to?
To Madeleine over
there? Or that child
holding that mangy
cat? Sacrebleu!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我还能跟谁说话？
跟那边的玛德琳？
还是那个抱着一只脏兮兮猫的孩子？
该死！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
Rrrroreow!
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
呜呜呜！
喵呜！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Goodness, you scared me!
What an ill natured kid!
Who brought this kid in?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
天哪，吓我一跳！
这孩子脾气真差！
是谁把这孩子带进来的？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I can't remember every
tyro who's begged me for
instruction in the culinary
arts. I could swear you've
come here months ago, it's
just--what was your name...?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我记不清每一个
求我传授烹饪技艺的学徒了。
我敢打赌你几个月前就来了，
只是——你叫什么名字来着...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Bah! No matter.
I suppose that's
of no importance
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
算了，无所谓。
我想这现在
并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
E-excuse me? I may be
your instructor, but you
can call me by my first name.
I know that I can be strict,
but please: in the end, we are colleagues, even if I am superior.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
呃...请原谅？我虽然
是你的导师，但你可以
直接叫我的名字。
我知道我可能很严格，
但请听我说：归根结底，我们是同事，
即使我是上级。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Fine, fine...
If you insist on your
modicum of expressed
respect, then you may
call me ''Sir Charles.''
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好吧，好吧...
如果你坚持要表达
那一点尊重，
那你可以叫我“查尔斯先生”。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah... That does have
a rather fine ring to it.
I actually earned that title
from the king himself, even
if I'm a knight only in title and manner, rather than strength.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊...这听起来
确实很顺口。
这个头衔其实是国王亲自授予我的，
即使我只在头衔和举止上是骑士，
而非在实力上。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well then, let's get started
today with making a simple
dish. Okay, ^FF0000I don't teach recipes
more than once^000000, ^FF0000so make sure
that you write this down^000000. Now
then, what shall we cook?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
那么，让我们今天
从做一道简单的菜开始吧。好的，^FF0000我不会重复教食谱^000000，^FF0000所以请确保你把它记下来^000000。
那么，我们要做什么菜？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, how about
'Fried Grasshopper Legs?'
To the uninitiated, it may
seem to be a disgusting dish,
but trust me, its exquisite taste is pure pleasure for your palate.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊哈，怎么样，
“油炸蚂蚱”？
对于外行来说，这可能
看起来是一道令人反感的菜，
但相信我，它 exquisite 的味道
是味蕾的纯粹享受。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, please bring
^4D4DFF5 Grasshopper Legs^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Old Frying Pan^000000.
Then, we can begin.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
现在，请带来
^4D4DFF5 蚂蚱^000000、
^4D4DFF1 食用油^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1 破旧平底锅^000000。
然后，我们就可以开始了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, I've got it!
Let's make ''Grape Juice
Herbal Tea.'' The weather
is perfect right now for
a cool, refreshing drink.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，我想到了！
让我们做“葡萄汁草本茶”吧。现在的天气
非常适合来一杯清凉解渴的饮料。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please bring
^4D4DFF3 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF2 Red Potions^000000
so that we can
begin the lesson~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请带来
^4D4DFF3葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF2红色药水^000000，
这样我们就可以开始上课了~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I've got it~
We can make
''Honey Grape Juice.''
Please bring me the
following ingredients so
that we can begin the lesson.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我想到了~
我们可以做
“蜂蜜葡萄汁”。
请带来以下材料，
这样我们就可以开始上课了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
^4D4DFF1 Honey^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
^4D4DFF1蜂蜜^000000、
^4D4DFF2葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1红色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mmm, why don't we
make ''Frog Egg and
Squid Ink Soup?'' Those
bereft of gourmet taste may
think it's disgusting, but it's
actually quite scrumptious.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
嗯，我们为什么不做
“蛙卵墨汁汤”呢？那些
缺乏美食鉴赏力的人可能会
觉得它很恶心，但它其实
非常美味。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well then,
please bring me
^4D4DFF1 Bag of Grain^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Spawns^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Squid Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
那么，
请带来
^4D4DFF1谷物袋^000000、
^4D4DFF10蛙卵^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1墨汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, I know what
would be perfect right
now. ''Steamed Crab
Nippers.'' Now, please
bring these ingredients
so we can make this soup.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，我知道现在
什么最完美了。“蒸蟹钳”。
现在，请带来这些材料，
这样我们就可以做这道汤了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
We'll need
^4D4DFF10 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Nippers^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我们需要
^4D4DFF10绿色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF10蟹钳^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1黄色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ooh, you know what
would be scrumptious?
''Fried Monkey Tails.'' Yes,
that sounds perfect! Please
bring these ingredients so
that I can teach you this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
噢，你知道什么
会非常美味吗？
“热炒猴尾巴”。是的，
听起来很完美！请带来这些材料，
这样我就可以教你这道菜了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
We'll need
^4D4DFF1 Frying Pan^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Yoyo Tails^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我们需要
^4D4DFF1平底锅^000000、
^4D4DFF5溜溜猴尾巴^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Scrub the Grasshopper Legs
as cleanly as you can before
placing them in the Frying Pan.
Afterwards, pour half a bottle of Cooking Oil and fry the legs at
high heat for about 20 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
把蚂蚱腿尽可能
清洗干净，然后放入平底锅。
之后，倒入半瓶食用油，
用大火炸大约20分钟。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, follow the instructions
that I've just given you to the
letter! Hmmm... Good, good.
That's not bad at all. Alright,
you're almost there...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
现在，请严格按照
我刚才给你的指示去做！嗯...很好，很好。
这还不错。好的，
你快成功了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hurry and bring me
the ingredients to make
Fried Grasshopper Legs!
If a restaurant patron had
ordered this, then you'd
already be making him wait!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
快点把做油炸蚂蚱的
材料带来！
如果有餐厅客人点了这道菜，
那你已经在让他等待了！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Just go and ambush those
happy-go-lucky grasshoppers
just playing in the fields. Hurry and smash them, then rip their
legs off--but be humane about it!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
只要去埋伏那些
在田野里无忧无虑玩耍的蚂蚱。
快点打倒它们，然后撕下它们的腿——
但要人道一点！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You extract the juice
from the Grapes like this--
we can't use pre-made Grape
Juice for the sake of freshness. Then, you need to boil the Red
Potions in a bain-marie...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
像这样从葡萄中
榨出汁液——为了新鲜度，
我们不能使用现成的葡萄汁。然后，你需要
用隔水加热法煮沸红色药水...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When the Red Potions
reach the right consistency,
gently stir in the juice that you just squeezed from the Grapes.
Now, I want you to try it. Hmm... That's not bad... Good, good...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
当红色药水
达到合适的稠度时，
轻轻搅拌你刚从葡萄中榨出的汁液。
现在，我想让你尝尝。嗯...还不错...很好，很好...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What are you doing?
Hurry and bring me the
ingredients for Grape Juice
Herbal Tea! At a real restaurant, you'd never be able to take your
time like this! Quickly, now!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你在做什么？
快点把做葡萄汁草本茶的
材料带来！在真正的餐厅里，你
绝对不可能像这样慢慢吞吞！快点，现在！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Having trouble finding
Grapes? Just pop open
those cute little Poporings...
Of course, you should try to
be humane when you hunt them...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
找不到葡萄？
只要打开那些可爱的波波利...
当然，你在狩猎它们的时候
应该尽量人道一点...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
First, skin the Grapes
and extract the seeds. Then,
blend the Grapes with the
Honey. Take this blended
mixture and carefully stir
it into the Red Potion...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
首先，剥去葡萄皮并取出籽。然后，
将葡萄与蜂蜜混合。取这份混合液，
小心地将其搅拌进红色药水中...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When the pulp is fully
mixed into the Red Potion,
you'll be finished. Now, go
and try making it yourself.
Right, that's good. Yes...
Wait, wait! Okay, there you go~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
当果肉完全融入红色药水后，
就完成了。现在，去试着做一下。
很好，不错。是的...
等等，等等！好了，就是这样~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What's taking you so
long? You should have
brought me the ingredients
to make Honey Grape Juice
a while ago. Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你怎么这么慢？
你应该早就把做蜂蜜葡萄汁的
材料带来了。快点！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You're having trouble
finding some Honey for the
Honey Grape Juice, aren't you?
Just go and hunt some bears,
they're always carrying some
of that Honey around.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你是在找蜂蜜做蜂蜜葡萄汁
遇到困难了吗？
去猎杀一些熊吧，
它们身上总是带着一些蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mill the grain until
it's a fine flour, then
boil the Squid Ink at
medium heat. Once it
bubbles, pour in the flour.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
将谷物磨成细粉，然后
用中火煮沸墨汁。一旦
开始冒泡，就倒入面粉。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Keep stirring, slowly
adding the Spawns. When
it all boils again, reduce the
heat and simmer for about 10
minutes. Okay, now you try it.
That's good, good... Alright~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
继续搅拌，慢慢加入蛙卵。
当再次沸腾时，调小火
炖煮约10分钟。好了，现在你来试试。
很好，不错... 好吧~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What are you doing?
You're supposed to be
preparing ingredients
for Frog Egg and Squid
Ink Soup right now!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你在做什么？
你现在应该正在准备
蛙卵墨汁汤的材料！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You have to be careful
when you're handling Frog
Eggs. If you feed them raw to
somebody, well, their flavor is
decidely less than magnifique.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
处理蛙卵时要小心。
如果你生吃给别人，
嗯，味道肯定不太美妙。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Boil the Nippers in Yellow
Potion on low heat for about
30 minutes. Then, bring it down
to a simmer and carefully stir
in the Green Herbs one by one.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
将蟹钳放入黄色药水中，
用小火煮约30分钟。然后，
转小火慢炖，并小心地
逐一加入绿色药草。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
This is an easy recipe, but
I still want you to demonstrate
for me. Okay, let's see now...
You're doing fine. Now, wait...
Good, good, okay, it's ready
for the Green Herbs now...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
这是一个简单的食谱，
但我还是想让你演示一下。
好的，让我看看...
你做得不错。现在，等一下...
很好，不错，好了，现在可以
加入绿色药草了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Shouldn't you be
preparing all of the
ingredients for Steamed
Crab Nippers? You need
to work quickly for those
hungry restaurant patrons!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你不应该正在准备
清蒸蟹钳的所有材料吗？
为了那些饥饿的餐厅顾客，
你需要动作快点！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
It shouldn't be too hard
to gather Nippers. Just
find some Vadons and crush
them, making sure to rip off
their Nippers. That sounds strange, I know, but just do it.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
收集蟹钳不应该太难。
只要找到一些螃蟹，
把它们压碎，确保撕下
它们的蟹钳。我知道这听起来很奇怪，
但照做就是了。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Finally, you're here! Never
forget: your ingredients must
always be as fresh as possible.
If not, your cuisine will be much poorer in quality. Now, let me
explain how to make this dish.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
终于来了！永远记住：你的材料
必须尽可能新鲜。
如果不新鲜，你的料理质量
就会大打折扣。现在，让我
解释一下如何制作这道菜。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Pluck the hair from the
tails and rinse them well
under cold water. Pour half
a bottle of Cooking Oil unto
a preheated pan, and then
quickly fry the tails.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
拔掉尾巴上的毛，并在冷水下
冲洗干净。在预热的锅中倒入
半瓶食用油，然后
快速煎炸尾巴。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
The trick is to fry the
tails quickly without burning
them, so you'll probably want
to cook using medium-high heat.
Show me what you've learned now... Alright, that's not bad... Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
诀窍是快速煎炸尾巴而不烧焦，
所以你可能想用中高火烹饪。
现在展示一下你学到的... 好吧，还不错... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There, you're done!
The presentation can use
a little work, but at least you
know this recipe now. That's
all for today, so please go
and practice on your own now.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，完成了！
摆盘还可以再改进一下，但至少你
已经掌握这个食谱了。今天就到这里，
请去自己练习一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You better go prepare
those ingredients for Fried
Monkey Tails are quickly as
you can. In a real restaurant,
you'd never able to take your
time like this. Toute allure!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你最好尽快去准备
炸猴尾的材料。在真正的餐厅里，
你绝对不可能像这样慢慢吞吞。Toute allure!

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You need more tails?
Just sneak up on some
Yoyos, swiftly kill them,
and then slice off their tails.
You're a beginner, but I won't
allow you to be inhumane!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你需要更多尾巴？
只要悄悄接近一些溜溜猴，
迅速杀死它们，
然后切下它们的尾巴。
你是个新手，但我不会允许你
不人道地对待它们！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh... I'm so exhausted!
I have too much wisdom and
skills to pass on! Teaching is
not an endeavor I enjoy, but
I do realize it is necessary
for my cuisine to survive me...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦... 我太累了！
我有太多的智慧和技能
要传授！教学并不是
我喜欢的活动，但我意识到
这是为了让我的料理在我之后
得以延续...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Peser le bien et le mal...
Even though it pains me,
I suppose I have to continue
teaching until one of you can
become a worthy successor.
It will take some time...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
Peser le bien et le mal...
虽然这很痛苦，
我想我必须继续教学，
直到你们中有人能成为
合格的接班人。
这需要一些时间...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Strange, strange...
What is that kid and
that cat doing here?
The kitchen is no place
for them--at the very least,
not for pets, you know.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
奇怪，奇怪...
那个小孩和那只猫
在这里做什么？
厨房不是他们的地方——
至少，宠物是不允许的，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Pardon moi, child,
but would you remove
yourself and your cat
from the premises? This
is a kitchen, and everything
here needs to be clean!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
Pardon moi, 孩子，
但你能不能带着你的猫
离开这里？这是厨房，
这里的一切都需要保持干净！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...Nyaaa?
...Meow?
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
...喵？
...喵？

scripts.text: What's your name, kid?
scripts.translation: 你叫什么名字，小孩？

scripts.text: Do you want to eat something?
scripts.translation: 你想吃点东西吗？

scripts.text: Here, kitty~
scripts.translation: 这里，小猫咪~

scripts.text: Get out!
scripts.translation: 滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyaaa~
nyaaa~
(Purrrrrr)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
喵~
喵~
（呼噜呼噜）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
.....Who told you
to ask her name?
You don't even understand what she is saying.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
.....谁让你问她名字的？
你甚至听不懂她在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyaaaa~
(Purrrrrr~)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
喵~
（呼噜呼噜~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
That was a good idea...
Offering them food to get
them to leave. Mon dieu, if
the child won't talk to us...
Still, we need to get those
two out of the kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
这是个好主意...
给它们食物让它们离开。天哪，
如果这孩子不肯跟我们说话...
总之，我们需要把这两只
赶出厨房。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha~
Nyhhahaha~
(Meow, meow~)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
喵哈哈~
喵哈哈~
（喵，喵~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
...Are you playing with that kid...?
...Then I don't need you to be here.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
...你在逗那个小孩玩...？
...那你不需要留在这里了。

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...
(Meow?)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
...
（喵？）

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
(RRRrrreow!)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
咕噜噜！
（喵呜！）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, look out!
You should have
been more careful
handling that cat...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，小心！
你处理那只猫的时候
应该更小心一点...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Alright, enough
is enough. We can't
continue to cook if we
have live animals in the
kitchen. It's a violation
of our sanitary standards!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，够了。
如果厨房里有活物，
我们就没法继续做饭了。
这违反了我们的卫生标准！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I'm sorry, mon chere,
but you have to leave.
Child, please take your
cat and head out the door
before your feline can touch
or shed on any of the food!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
对不起，亲爱的，
但你必须离开。
孩子，请带着你的猫
从门口出去，
别让那只猫碰到或掉毛在
任何食物上！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Grrrrrrr!
RRRRreow!
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
咕噜噜！
喵呜！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh...!
Nyuyang, there
you are! What are
you doing here in
Charles's kitchen?
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哦...！
妮扬，你在这里！
你在查尔斯的厨房
做什么？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
M-Madam Wickebine...!
Forgive me, you surprised
me by appearing from out
of nowhere. Do you happen
to know this young child?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
维...维克贝恩夫人...！
请原谅，你突然出现
吓了我一跳。你认识
这个小孩吗？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, Nyuyang here is my
little sister. It may be hard
to see the resemblance...
Anyway, I've been looking
all over for her. Are you
bothering Charles, Nyuyang?
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哦，这里的妮扬是
我的妹妹。可能很难看出
你们有血缘关系...
总之，我一直在找她。
妮扬，你在打扰查尔斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyuuuunyuuu~
nyuuuunyuuu~
Meooooow~
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
喵呜~
喵呜~
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
...!!!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
...！！！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, so you have
been bothering him!
You think Charles
wants you to leave?
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哦，看来你
确实打扰到他了！
你觉得查尔斯
想让你离开吗？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hahahahah, what
are you talking about!
Nonsense! How can 
such a cute little belle
be of any trouble to me?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哈哈哈哈哈，
你在说什么呀！
真是胡闹！这么可爱
的小贝尔怎么会打扰到我呢？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
As a matter of fact,
I was just about to treat
this precious petit and
her little cat to some
of my delicious cuisine.
So do not worry, Madam~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
事实上，
我正准备招待
这位珍贵的小贝尔
和她的小猫品尝
我美味的料理。
所以请放心，夫人~

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you sure, Charles?
I know how serious you
are about your cooking,
and I don't want Nyuyang
to disturb you in any way...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
你确定吗，查尔斯？
我知道你对烹饪
有多认真，
我不希望妮扬
以任何方式打扰到你...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oh, Charles, you've
been nothing but kind
to me. I'm glad that you're
also taking care of Nyuyang.
Well then, take care~
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哦，查尔斯，你一直
对我很好。很高兴你
也在照顾妮扬。
那么，再见~

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
Nyahahaha~
Nyahahaha~
(Meow, meow~)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
嘻嘻哈哈~
嘻嘻哈哈~
（喵，喵~）

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
......
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
......

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah...
There goes a true
lady... Madam Wickebine...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊...
真是一位
真正的女士... 维克贝恩夫人...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
It's been bothering
me that his highness
has been missing for
a while. Why doesn't
anybody know where he is?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
一直困扰我的是，
陛下已经失踪
一段时间了。为什么
没有人知道他在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wise and benevolent
King Tristram III would
never abandon his subjects.
I dearly hope that nothing
serious has happened to him...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
英明仁慈的
特里斯坦三世国王
绝不会抛弃他的子民。
我衷心希望他没有
发生什么严重的事情...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Can it be possible that
our beloved king would
have enemies? He's done
nothing but good for the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
and the rest of the world!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
难道有可能
我们敬爱的国王
有敌人吗？他为
卢恩·米德加兹王国
和世界其他地方
所做的一切都是好事！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I can't imagine a great
man like him to be in any
sort of trouble. It makes me
me laugh whenever anyone
suggests that he is hiding
in the Schwarzwald Republic...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我无法想象像他这样
伟大的人会陷入
任何麻烦。每当有人
暗示他躲在
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国时，
我就忍不住发笑...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Praise the glories of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
Long live King Tristram III!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
赞美卢恩·米德加兹王国的荣耀！
特里斯坦三世国王万岁！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, I'm in great need of
some rest. Unless you 
have something incredibly
important to ask of me,
please let me take a break~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，我很需要
休息一下。除非你有
极其重要的事情要问我，
请让我休息一下~

scripts.text: I want to learn more recipes.
scripts.translation: 我想学习更多食谱

scripts.text: For whom do you cook?
scripts.translation: 你为谁烹饪？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you...
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你了...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You want to learn more
recipes? I suppose that
you should borrow another
cookbook then. Before that,
please return the cookbook
that you were studying, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你想学习更多
食谱？我想你应该
再借一本食谱。在那之前，
请把你正在研究的食谱还给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, choose the cookbook
that you want to borrow by
entering a level from 1 to 5.
There are more advanced books,
but I'm not lending those out.
Oh, and enter 0 to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
那么，请输入1到5之间的等级，
选择你想借阅的烹饪书。
还有更高级的书，
但那些我不会外借。
哦，输入0可以取消。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Hmm...
I asked to you to
enter a level from
1 to 5. Those are the
only cookbooks that I will
lend out to my students.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
嗯...
我让你输入
1到5之间的等级。
那些是我
唯一会借给
学生的烹饪书。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you changed your mind?
It would be a good idea to
study the recipes that you
have right now before trying
something new, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
所以你改变主意了？
我想，在尝试新东西之前，
先好好研究一下你现在的食谱
是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you wanted to borrow a
Level {0} Cookbook, eh?
Oh, would you please tell
me the level of the cookbook
that you are returning to me?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
所以你想借
{0}级烹饪书，是吗？
哦，请告诉我
你要还给我的烹饪书
是什么等级的？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
There must be some
kind of mistake-- I only
lend out cookbooks from
levels 1 to 5. Hmm, well, ask
me again when you remember
which cookbook you have, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
一定有什么
误会——我只借出
1到5级的烹饪书。嗯，好吧，
等你想起自己拿的是哪本烹饪书，
再来问我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you changed your mind?
It would be a good idea to
study the recipes that you
have right now before trying
something new, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
所以你改变主意了？
我想，在尝试新东西之前，
先好好研究一下你现在的食谱
是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Why do you want to
borrow a copy of the
cookbook that you already
have? I guess you made
some sort of mistake?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
等等，等等...
你为什么想借一本
你已经有的烹饪书？
我想你一定是搞错了？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Why don't you have
the book that you said
that you'd return to me?
Find it first, and then I can
lend another cookbook to you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
等等，等等...
你为什么没有
你说要还给我的那本书？
先找到它，然后我
才能再借给你一本烹饪书。

scripts.text: [Charles Orleans]
scripts.translation: [查尔斯·奥尔良]

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, so you're done
with the Level 1 Cookbook.
That's good, that means you're
ready to graduate from the most
basic of basics. From now on,
the recipes will be harder...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，所以你
已经看完1级烹饪书了。
很好，这意味着你
已经准备好从最基础的
基础毕业了。从现在开始，
食谱会变得更难...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, so what did you
think of the recipes in
the Level 2 Cookbook?
Homestyle cooking may be
simple, but it should never
be neglected by chefs.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，那么你觉得
2级烹饪书里的食谱
怎么样？家常菜可能
很简单，但厨师
绝不应该忽视它。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ah, done with the Level 3
Cookbook already? The recipes
in there are really good when you're cooking romantic dinners.
They'll come in handy someday,
if you know what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，这么快就看完
3级烹饪书了？里面的食谱
在做浪漫晚餐时真的很棒。
总有一天你会用上的，
如果你明白我的意思的话。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
So you've finished the
Level 4 Cookbook. That's
no small feat! You've got to
use very strange ingredients
to create delicious cuisine!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
所以你完成了
4级烹饪书。这可不是
小事！你必须使用
非常奇怪的食材
才能做出美味的菜肴！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You're done with the
Level 5 Cookbook? Good
work: most beginners don't
even get this far. I suppose
you'll want to review some
of the easier recipes now~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你看完
5级烹饪书了？干得好：
大多数初学者
甚至都走不到这一步。我想
你现在想复习一些
更简单的食谱~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Now, before I let you
borrow one of my beloved
cookbooks, I have a small
condition that you must fulfill.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
现在，在我让你
借走我珍爱的
烹饪书之前，我有一个
小条件你必须满足。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
When I was a young child,
my family was destitute to
the point where we live off
leftover vegetables. Even
Monster's Feed was a prime
delicacy back in those days.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
当我还是个小孩子的时候，
我的家穷到
靠吃剩菜度日。即使是
魔物饲料，在当时
也是难得的美味。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Back then, my father would
always serve us Pumpkin.
I grew sick of it as a boy, but
now it brings back memories
of those days of innocence.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
那时候，我父亲
总是给我们吃南瓜。
我小时候吃腻了，
但现在它让我想起了
那些纯真的日子。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Why don't we do this?
If you bring me 10 Pumpkins,
I will let you borrow one of
my Level 1 Cookbooks.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我们这样怎么样？
如果你给我带10个南瓜，
我就让你借一本
我的1级烹饪书。

scripts.text: Give 10 Pumpkins and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出10个南瓜和当前烹饪书

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Perfect, you've brought
me 10 Pumpkins! I can't
want to taste these flavors
that I used to experience
everyday in my childhood.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
完美，你带给我
10个南瓜了！我迫不及待
想尝尝这些味道，
它们是我小时候
每天都体验到的。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, how I miss the
taste of Pumpkins!
Ahhh, how nostalgic~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，我多么想念
南瓜的味道！
啊，多么怀旧~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Today, I have a craving
for a cup of tea. Of course,
you cannot enjoy tea without
crackers or cookies. Please
bring me 5 Well-Baked Cookies
to borrow my Level 2 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
今天，我特别想喝杯茶。
当然，喝茶不能没有饼干或曲奇。
请给我带5个姜饼，
我就让你借我的2级烹饪书。

scripts.text: Give Cookies and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出姜饼和当前烹饪书

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, you brought these
cookies much quicker
than I had expected!
Great, now I can put
the tea on, relax, then
enjoy a delicious snack~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，你比我预想的还要快就带来了这些饼干！
太好了，现在我可以泡上茶，
放松一下，然后享用美味的点心~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ohh...
I must have some tea
soon... But the experience
isn't complete without any
Well-Baked Cookies to munch~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦...
我快得喝点茶了...
但没有姜饼配着吃，
这体验就不完整~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
You know that specialty
dish from Amatsu? I've
been craving that lately.
Please bring me 5 Sushi,
and I'll let you borrow a
Level 3 Cookbook, okay?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你知道樱花城的那道特色菜吗？
我最近一直很想吃。
请给我带5个明虾寿司，
我就让你借我的3级烹饪书，好吗？

scripts.text: Give Sushi and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出明虾寿司和当前烹饪书

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ooh, these look so fresh!
And the presentation is also
wonderful! These must have
been prepared by a skilled chef!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
噢，这些看起来真新鲜！
摆盘也很漂亮！
这一定是位技艺高超的厨师做的！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Ahhh, Sushi...
It's one of the few
things I don't know
how to make extremely
well. Can you believe that?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
啊，明虾寿司...
这是少数几样
我做得不够完美的东西之一。
你能相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh, I'm in the mood for
some cuisine from Kunlun.
Would you bring me some of
that delicious Bao? 5 would
be perfect. Then, I'll let you
borrow my Level 4 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦，我现在想吃昆仑的料理了。
你能给我带点那美味的包子吗？
5个就完美了。然后，
我就让你借我的4级烹饪书。

scripts.text: Give Bao and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出包子和当前烹饪书

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Great, you actually
brought them! These
Bao look especially
scrumptious! I can't
wait to have a taste!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
太好了，你真的带来了！
这些包子看起来格外诱人！
我迫不及待想尝尝了！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Oh...
It's been so long
since I've had a taste
of that delicious Bao.
I'd cook it myself, but
I don't know the secret!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
哦...
我已经很久没吃到
那美味的包子了。
我自己也能做，
但我不知道秘诀！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Lately, my pantry has been
in some dire need of Shoots.
They're a tasty ingredient with
unignorable health value. Bring
me 10 of those, and you can
borrow a Level 5 Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
最近，我的储藏室急需一些笋。
它们是一种美味且营养价值不容忽视的食材。
给我带10个，
你就可以借我的5级烹饪书。

scripts.text: Give Shoots and Current Cookbook
scripts.translation: 交出笋和当前烹饪书

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Goodness, these are
some high quality Shoots!
These look so good, I'm
sure that you you can
even eat them raw!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
天哪，这些笋质量真高！
看起来这么好吃，
我敢肯定你甚至可以直接生吃！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
I'm going to need to
cook with those Shoots
soon, so I'd appreciate it
if you'd do this little favor~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
我很快就要用这些笋做饭了，
所以如果你能帮这个小忙，
我会很感激的~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Well, as promised,
here's the cookbook
that you asked for. Take
good care of it--don't sell
it or lose it or anything like
that. Good luck cooking now~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
好了，如你所愿，
这是你要的烹饪书。
请好好保管——
不要卖掉或弄丢之类的。
祝你烹饪顺利~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
What do you mean,
''Who do I cook for?''
That's a strange question
with a simple answer. I'm
an artiste that must bring
more of my art into the world.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
你什么意思，
“我为谁做饭？”
这是个奇怪的问题，
但答案很简单。
我是一个艺术家，
必须将更多的艺术带入世界。

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Wait, wait...
Have you been speaking
to Madeleine Chu? She
didn't say anything out
of the ordinary did she?
Because if she did, ignore her!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
等等，等等...
你是在和玛德琳·朱说话吗？
她没说什么奇怪的话吧？
因为如果她说了，请忽略她！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
No. There is
no special reason
why my spirit to create
culinary masterpieces has
been reinvigorated lately...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
不。
我最近创作烹饪杰作的
热情重新燃起，
并没有特殊的原因...

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Please, do not worry
yourself about it. Just
let me rest for now~
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
请别担心。
现在让我先休息一下~

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mon dieu!
An error has
occurred!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
天哪！
发生错误了！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I'm sorry, but right now
you're carrying too many
items. You should put your
extra things in Kafra Storage,
and then talk to me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
抱歉，您现在携带的物品太多了。
请把多余的东西存入卡普拉仓库，
然后再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, hello~
I'm Madeleine Chu,
chef apprentice to
Sir Charles. May I help
you with anything today?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，你好~
我是玛德琳·朱，
查尔斯·奥尔良先生的厨师学徒。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What do you do as a chef?
scripts.translation: 作为厨师，你是做什么的？

scripts.text: Which foods can you make?
scripts.translation: 你会做哪些食物？

scripts.text: I want to learn cooking too!
scripts.translation: 我也想学做饭！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
What do I do as a chef?
Well, I'm just an apprentice now, so I'm still learning how to cook.
But someday, I want to become
a great chef and have everybody
recognize my culinary talents~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
作为厨师，我做什么呢？
嗯，我现在只是个学徒，所以还在学做饭。
但总有一天，我想成为一名伟大的厨师，
让所有人都认可我的烹饪才华~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
There's a lot of grueling
work that goes into cooking,
as well as a lot of finesse.
I have to control fire better
tham a firefighter and craft
my dishes like an artist.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
烹饪需要大量的艰苦工作，
也需要很多技巧。
我必须比消防员更擅长控制火候，
像艺术家一样创作我的菜肴。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I'm exaggerating
a little bit, but cooking
at a certain level is much
more difficult than it appears.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯，我有点夸张了，
但达到一定水平的烹饪
比看起来要难得多。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I only know the basic
recipes for now. Sir Charles
says that even the best chef
knows how to bring out the
flavors of even common foods.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯，我现在只知道基础食谱。
查尔斯·奥尔良先生说，
即使是最好的厨师，
也能从普通食物中激发出美味。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
He says that I need to develop
my culinary skills until I can
learn more advanced recipes.
Someday, I'll advance and then
I'll know enough to create my
own unique, delicious dishes!
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
他说我需要磨练烹饪技巧，
直到能学习更高级的食谱。
总有一天，我会进阶，
然后就能创造出
属于我自己的独特美味佳肴！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sir Charles may be harsh to
his students, but his skills
are unequaled. I tried one of
his desserts once, and it was
the most heavenly experience.
I swear I saw winged hearts~!
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
查尔斯·奥尔良先生对学生可能很严厉，
但他的技艺无人能及。
我尝过他的一道甜点，
那是最天堂般的体验。
我发誓我看到了长着翅膀的心~！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sadly, I'm a still long way
from learning how to make 
his specialty, Handmade
Chocolates. Before that, I need
to master these strange recipes
that he keeps teaching me...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
遗憾的是，我离学会制作
他的招牌菜——手工巧克力
还有很长的路要走。
在那之前，我需要掌握
他一直教我的那些奇怪食谱...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
If you want to learn cooking,
why don't you ask Sir Charles?
He's fairly harsh to his students, but he does it out of tough love.
He demands nothing less than
absolute perfection, you know.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
如果你想学做饭，
为什么不问问查尔斯·奥尔良先生呢？
他对学生相当严厉，但那是出于严格的爱。
他要求绝对的完美，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
If you manage to get
Sir Charles to teach you
a recipe, you should practice
it over and over again to hone
your skills. Then, you'll find
yourself improving at cooking.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
如果你能让查尔斯·奥尔良先生
教你一道食谱，
你应该反复练习以磨练技巧。
然后，你会发现自己的烹饪技术在进步。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Now, Sir Charles will only
teach students that are truly
committed to cooking. You
might want to show your
dedication with the proper
attire... like a Chef Hat.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
现在，查尔斯·奥尔良先生
只会教那些真正致力于烹饪的学生。
你可能需要用合适的服装
来展示你的决心...比如厨师帽。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
But yes, Sir Charles
has very little patience for
beginners, meaning that
you'll have to be patient
with his teaching methods...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
但是是的，查尔斯·奥尔良先生
对初学者几乎没有耐心，
这意味着你必须对他的教学方法
保持耐心...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hello, is there any
way I can help you today?
Oh, if you're studying cooking
under Sir Charles, I can remind
you of the ingredients you need
if you've forgotten them~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你好，今天有什么
我可以帮你的吗？
哦，如果你正在查尔斯·奥尔良先生
门下学习烹饪，如果你忘记了
所需的食材，我可以提醒你~

scripts.text: Fried Grasshopper Legs
scripts.translation: 油炸蚂蚱

scripts.text: Grape Juice Herbal Tea
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁药草茶

scripts.text: Honey Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 蜂蜜葡萄汁

scripts.text: Frog Egg and Squid Ink Soup
scripts.translation: 蛙卵墨汁汤

scripts.text: Steamed Crab Nippers
scripts.translation: 蒸蟹螯

scripts.text: Fried Monkey Tails
scripts.translation: 热炒猴尾巴

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF5 Grasshopper Legs^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Old Frying Pan^000000 to make
fried Grasshopper Legs.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作油炸蚂蚱需要
^4D4DFF5蚂蚱腿^000000、
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1破旧平底锅^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF3 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF2 Red Potions^000000 for
Grape Juice Herbal Tea.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作葡萄汁药草茶需要
^4D4DFF3葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF2红色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Honey^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Grapes^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作蜂蜜葡萄汁需要
^4D4DFF1蜂蜜^000000、
^4D4DFF2葡萄^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1红色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Bag of Grain^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Spawns^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Squid Ink^000000 for Frog
Egg and Squid Ink soup.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作蛙卵墨汁汤需要
^4D4DFF1谷物袋^000000、
^4D4DFF10蛙卵^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1墨汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF10 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Nippers^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000 for
Steamed Crab Nippers.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作蒸蟹螯需要
^4D4DFF10绿色药草^000000、
^4D4DFF10蟹螯^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1黄色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh! You'll need
^4D4DFF1 Frying Pan^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Yoyo Tails^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Cooking Oil^000000 for
Fried Monkey Tails.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦！制作热炒猴尾巴需要
^4D4DFF1平底锅^000000、
^4D4DFF5溜溜猴尾巴^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1食用油^000000。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I know that Sir Charles
is stubborn and won't tell
you the ingredients again
if you forget. Anyway, I hope
you collect them and complete
the recipe as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我知道查尔斯·奥尔良先生很固执，如果你忘记了，他是不会再次告诉你食材的。总之，希望你能尽快收集齐食材并完成食谱~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sir Charles taught you
a recipe? That's great!
I hope you remember that the
quality of your dishes mostly
relies on your skills, so always remember to keep practicing.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
查尔斯·奥尔良先生教了你一道食谱？太棒了！
我希望你记住，菜肴的品质主要取决于你的技巧，所以请记得一直练习。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Ah, you know what might
help you improve your
culinary skills? Why don't
you borrow this cookbook
and try some of its recipes?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
啊，你知道什么能帮助你提升烹饪技巧吗？
何不借这本食谱，尝试一下里面的食谱呢？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Before you cook, make sure
that you have enough of the
ingredients. Oh, and keep the
cookbook nearby while you are
cooking. You'll probably need
to refer to it pretty often...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
在烹饪之前，请确保你有足够的食材。
哦，烹饪时请把食谱放在手边。你可能经常需要查阅它...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You might fail to make
edible food during your
first attempts, but you'll
improve as you practice. 
Please take this cookbook
with the basic Level 1 recipes.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
在最初的尝试中，你可能无法做出可食用的食物，但你会随着练习而进步。
请收下这本包含基础1级食谱的食谱。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Once you learn all the recipes,
feel free to come back to me for more, okay? Also, you'll need
these cooking kits to practice.
You can have these for free, and you can buy more from me later~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
一旦你学会了所有食谱，随时可以回来找我获取更多，好吗？
此外，你需要这些烹饪工具来练习。
这些可以免费给你，之后你可以从我这里购买更多~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
So how has your cooking
been coming along? You'll
need to practice to develop
your culinary skills. Now,
can I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
那么，你的烹饪进展如何？
你需要练习来提升烹饪技巧。
现在，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I need some Cooking Kits.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些烹饪工具

scripts.text: Will you try the food I cooked?
scripts.translation: 你要尝尝我做的食物吗？

scripts.text: How does the food I cooked look?
scripts.translation: 尝尝我做的食物

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sure, which kind
of Cooking Kits
did you need?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
当然可以，你需要哪种烹饪用具呢？

scripts.text: Outdoor Cooking Kit - 500z
scripts.translation: 野外烹饪用具 - 500z

scripts.text: Home Cooking Kit - 1,000z
scripts.translation: 家庭烹饪用具 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough skills
to use a Home Cooking Kit.
Please practice some more
with the Outdoor Cooking
Kits first, alright?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，抱歉，你的技能等级还不够使用家庭烹饪用具。
请先多练习一下野外烹饪用具，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please come back and
let me know if you need
to purchase any Cooking
Kits, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
如果需要购买烹饪用具，请随时回来找我，好吗？再见~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you've made a sample
of every recipe detailed in
that basic cookbook, did you?
That must have been very good training for your culinary skills.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，你已经把那本基础食谱里的每道菜都试做了一遍，是吗？
这对你的烹饪技巧来说是很好的训练。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I'd love to taste your
food and give my opinion,
but do you mind if I ask
you a favor first? I have
a friend in Payon who used
to study cooking in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我很想尝尝你的食物并给出评价，
但能先请你帮个忙吗？我在斐扬有个朋友，
他以前在普隆德拉学过烹饪。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
However, he became frustrated
with the culinary classes and
moved back to Prontera. Would
you mind asking him to taste
them? Here, I'll wrap your
food in this handy cloth...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
不过，他对烹饪课感到沮丧，
于是搬回了普隆德拉。你介意请他尝尝吗？
来，我用这块方便的手帕帮你包好食物...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
There you go, it's ready
to be delivered. Now, make
sure not to open this before
giving it to my old friend,
Chulsoo. You can find him
somewhere around Payon...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
好了，可以送出去了。现在，
在交给我的老朋友哲秀之前，
千万不要打开哦。你可以在斐扬附近找到他...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You should be able to
find Chulsoo around the
water mill or the pub in
Payon. Oh, and don't
forget to tell him that
I sent you, okay? Thanks~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你应该能在斐扬的水磨坊或酒馆附近找到哲秀。
哦，别忘了告诉他是我派你来的，好吗？谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hmm... I think it'd
be better if you tried
to make every recipe in
that basic cookbook I gave
you first. That way, I can more
accurately judge your skills.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯...我觉得最好先试着做一遍我给你的那本基础食谱里的所有菜。
这样，我才能更准确地判断你的水平。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
It's not bad to focus
on just one recipe, but
as a beginner, you need
to cover all of the basics.
Please read the cookbook that I gave you very carefully, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
只专注于一道菜也不错，
但作为初学者，你需要掌握所有基础。
请仔细阅读我给你的食谱，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I see that you've
tried some recipes in that
basic cookbook that I gave
you. Everything you made looks
delicious. All that's left now
is for someone to taste it...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，看来你已经尝试了我给你的那本基础食谱里的一些菜。
你做的每道菜看起来都很美味。现在只差有人来尝尝了...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well... I don't know...
I think you really should try
to make every recipe listed
in that basic cookbook that
I gave to you first. Then, you
can present your dishes~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯...我不确定...
我觉得你真的应该先试着做一遍我给你的那本基础食谱里的所有菜。
然后，你就可以展示你的厨艺了~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please find my friend
Chulsoo in Payon and
give him the Bundle of
Food so that he can taste
the dishes you've made.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
请去斐扬找到我的朋友哲秀，
把食物保鲜袋交给他，让他尝尝你做的菜。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Ah, hello~ oh, will you give me a second?
Right now, I am frying something so, I need to focus on this work for a while.
Hahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
啊，你好~ 哦，能给我一点时间吗？
我现在正在煎东西，需要专心一会儿。
哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, so have you met
my friend Chulsoo?
You brought him the
Bundle of Food, right?
I'd be disappointed if
you lost it or sold it...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，那你见过我的朋友哲秀了吗？
你把食物保鲜袋带给他了，对吧？
如果你弄丢了或者卖掉了，我会很失望的...

scripts.text: I did!
scripts.translation: 我做到了！

scripts.text: I lost the Bundle of Food!
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了食物保鲜袋！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hahaha, I suppose you
did. But even if you didn't
yet, make sure that you do
it soon, alright? See you~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哈哈，我相信你做到了。
不过即使你还没做，
也请快点去办，好吗？再见~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You lost it? Oh, that's
not good. How can you 
disrespect the culinary
arts in that way? I'm so
very ashamed of you...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你弄丢了？哎呀，这可不好。
怎么能这样不尊重烹饪艺术呢？
我真为你感到羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
First of all, I'd like
you to return my cookbook.
I want you to reflect on what
you've done, and then learn
cooking skills from Sir Charles, starting from the very beginning.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
首先，我希望你把我的食谱还给我。
我想让你反思一下你所做的事，
然后从查尔斯爵士那里重新学习烹饪技巧，从头开始。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you must be joking~
I'm sure you must have
hidden it somewhere.
Anyway, please deliver that
Bundle of Food to Chulsoo.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，你一定是在开玩笑吧~
我敢肯定你把它藏在某个地方了。
总之，请把食物保鲜袋交给哲秀。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I just received a
message from Chulsoo
thanking me for having
you send him that food.
I'm guessing that he
really liked it a lot.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我刚收到哲秀的来信，
感谢我把食物送给他。
我猜他一定非常喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I think you're ready to use
higher grade cooking tools now.
But never forget that your own
skills are the most important
factor in quality cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我想你现在可以使用更高级的烹饪用具了。
但永远不要忘记，
你自己的技巧才是决定美食质量的最重要因素。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please try these Indoor
Cooking Kits to help you
create more delicate dishes.
When you run out, feel free to
purchase more from me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
请试试这些室内烹饪用具，
它们能帮助你制作更精致的菜肴。
用完之后，随时可以向我购买更多，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Also, if you want to
learn some new recipes,
why don't you talk to Sir
Charles again? Okay then,
good luck, and I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
另外，如果你想学一些新食谱，
为什么不再去和查尔斯爵士谈谈呢？
好了，祝你好运，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
How are you? I hope
that you've been honing
your cooking skills since
the last time we've met.
Now, can I help you with
anything in particular?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你好吗？我希望
自上次见面以来，
你一直在磨练你的烹饪技巧。
现在，有什么我可以特别帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I need some Cooking Kits.
scripts.translation: 我需要一些烹饪工具

scripts.text: How is Sir Charles?
scripts.translation: 查尔斯爵士怎么样了？

scripts.text: Um, who's that kid?
scripts.translation: 那个小孩是谁？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Sure, which kind
of Cooking Kits
did you need?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
当然可以，你需要哪种烹饪用具呢？

scripts.text: Outdoor Cooking Kit - 500z
scripts.translation: 野外烹饪用具 - 500z

scripts.text: Home Cooking Kit - 1,000z
scripts.translation: 家庭烹饪用具 - 1,000z

scripts.text: Show me a different kit.
scripts.translation: 给我看看别的用具。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Well, I only have two
types of cooking kits,
although there is a superior
Professional Cooking Kit that
real experts, like Sir Charles,
use. Amazing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯，我只有两种烹饪用具，
不过还有一种更高级的高级烹饪用具，
像查尔斯爵士这样的真正专家会使用它。
真厉害，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You're still a beginner, so
my kits will serve you well. 
You know, there's a rumor about a cooking kit that can perfectly
make any recipe, so long as all of the ingredients are provided.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你还是个初学者，
所以我的用具很适合你。
你知道吗，有个传闻说有一种烹饪用具，
只要提供所有食材，就能完美地做出任何食谱。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Of course, it's only
a rumor, probably just
the result of someone's
weird imagination. I still
believe skill is the most
important ingredient~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
当然，那只是个传闻，
可能只是某人奇怪的想象。
我仍然相信技巧是最重要的食材~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Please come back and
let me know if you need
to purchase any Cooking
Kits, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
如果需要购买烹饪用具，请随时回来找我，好吗？再见~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Hm? Sir Charles is
fine, but lately he's been
getting a little upset at
even small things. Still,
I guess it's understandable.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
嗯？查尔斯爵士没事，
但最近他因为一些小事
有点不高兴。不过，
我想这也是可以理解的。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You know, when I first
met him, I assumed he was
only good at cooking sweets
like chocolates and caramels.
However, he is highly skilled
at cooking almost everything!
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
你知道吗，当我第一次见到他时，
我以为他只擅长做巧克力和糖果之类的甜点。
然而，他几乎擅长烹饪所有东西！

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I suppose he's been focusing
on foods other than desserts
ever since our king disappeared. I wonder if King Tristram III's
disappearance is related to Sir
Charles's change in mood?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我想自从我们的国王失踪后，
他就一直专注于甜点以外的食物。
我想知道国王特里斯坦三世的失踪
是否与查尔斯爵士的情绪变化有关？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I mean, Sir Charles seems
to be the type that has trouble
opening up to other people.
That may explain why he's much
nicer to women than to men.
Doesn't that make sense?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我的意思是，查尔斯爵士似乎
是那种很难向别人敞开心扉的人。
这可能解释了他为什么对女性比对男性更友善。
这说得通吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Maybe it's because he's
been experimenting with
a new recipe lately. I think he
mentioned something about
wanting to treat some woman
to the finest food ever made.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
也许是因为他最近一直在
尝试新的食谱。我想他提到过
想请一位女士品尝有史以来最美味的食物。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I've never seen Sir Charles
so excited before. That woman
must be very lucky: she has the
chance to eat his cooking every
day if she wanted! I'm almost
jealous of her, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我从未见过查尔斯爵士如此兴奋过。
那位女士一定非常幸运：
如果她愿意，她每天都能吃到他做的菜！
说实话，我都有点嫉妒她了。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, you mean the
child with the cat?
I'm not sure, but I think
I overheard that she might
be the younger sister of
Madam Wickebine.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
哦，你是说那个抱猫的孩子吗？
我不太确定，但我好像听到过，
她可能是维克贝恩夫人的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I wonder why Sir Charles
gives Madam Wickebine such
special treatment. Whenever
I ask him about it, he gets so
upset and doesn't say anything!
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
我想知道为什么查尔斯爵士
对维克贝恩夫人如此特别。
每次我问起这件事，
他都会很生气，什么都不肯说！

scripts.text:
[Charles Orleans]
Mince alors!
I just felt a chill down my
spine... Could someone
be talking about me?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯·奥尔良]
天哪！
我刚才突然感到一阵寒意...
难道有人在谈论我吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Error occurred.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
发生错误。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
How many {0}
Cooking Kits would
you like to buy? If you
want to cancel, please
enter the number 0.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
您想购买多少份{0}烹饪套装？
如果您想取消，请输入数字0。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
You've changed your
mind? Well, if you need
to buy {0}
Kits later, just come back
to me at anytime, alright?
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
您改变主意了吗？
如果您之后需要购买{0}份套装，
随时都可以回来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I'm sorry, but
I don't sell more than
100 {0}
at a time, just to be safe.
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
很抱歉，为了安全起见，
我一次最多只卖100份{0}。

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
can't afford this many
{0}
Please check your zeny
before purchasing my kits~
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足以购买这么多{0}。
请在购买我的套装前检查一下您的Zeny~

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough room in your
Inventory for this many
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
很抱歉，您的背包空间不足以存放这么多{0}...

scripts.text:
[Madeleine Chu]
Here you are~
Best of luck with
your culinary training!
scripts.translation:
[玛德琳·朱]
给您~
祝您的烹饪训练顺利！

scripts.text:
[Child with Cat]
...Nya?
(...Meow?)

[Child with Cat]
Nyahahahaha,
nyahahahaha~
(Meow~, meow~)
scripts.translation:
[抱猫的孩子]
喵哈哈哈，
喵哈哈哈~
(喵~，喵~)

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Hold on, you're carrying
too many items with you.
Why don't you put some of
your stuff in Kafra Storage
before coming back to me?
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
等一下，你携带的物品太多了。
为什么不在回来找我之前，
先把一些东西存入卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
When you get the chance,
please give Madeline my
thanks. I'll visit Prontera
soon to see her, as well as
make amends with Sir Charles.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
如果有机会，请代我向玛德琳致谢。
我很快会去普隆德拉看她，
也会去和查尔斯爵士和解。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
How would you like
to buy a Rice Cake?
It's only 200 zeny, but
it's oh-so-delicious~
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
你想买一块Q弹的长条糕吗？
只要200 Zeny，但它非常美味~

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy one!
scripts.translation: 好的，我要买一块！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Actually, Madeleine sent me...
scripts.translation: 其实，是玛德琳派我来的...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Oh, I'm sorry, but
you don't have enough
money to buy a Rice Cake...
Still, it should be easy to
raise 200 zeny, right?
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
很抱歉，您的钱不够买一块Q弹的长条糕...
不过，凑齐200 Zeny应该不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Thank you very
much! I hope you
enjoy your Rice Cake~
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
非常感谢！
希望您喜欢您的Q弹的长条糕~

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Are you sure about
that? You won't get
the chance to have a
Rice Cake this delicious
anywhere else. Oh well,
that means more for me~
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
你确定吗？
别处可吃不到这么美味的Q弹的长条糕哦。
算了，那正好留给我吃~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, Madeleine
sent me here to find
you. She said that you'd
be willing to taste test
the food in this bundle...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，是玛德琳派我
来找您的。
她说您愿意品尝
这个食物保鲜袋里的食物...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Madeleine? You mean
Madeleine Chu? Oh, I haven't
heard from her in such a long
time! Great, let me see the
bundle that she sent me. Ah, everything here looks appetizing!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
玛德琳？你是说
玛德琳·朱？
好久没听到她的消息了！
太好了，让我看看
她寄来的食物保鲜袋。
啊，里面的东西看起来都很诱人！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Oh, wait. She even
included a message
inside this bundle.
Let's see, here...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
哦，等等。
这个食物保鲜袋里
还有一封信。
让我看看，这里...

scripts.text:
^333333Dear Chulsoo,
 It's been a long time.
I know you left Prontera on
bad terms with Sir Charles,
but please understand that
he was only trying his best to
help improve your cooking.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333亲爱的哲秀：
好久不见。
我知道你和查尔斯爵士
闹得很不愉快才离开普隆德拉，
但请理解，
他只是想尽力帮助你
提升厨艺。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333 Sir Charles always wished
that you'd expand your repetoire, and that you'd make these kinds
of foods someday. The person
that delivered this food also
cooked it. Please try it...^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333查尔斯爵士一直希望
你能拓展你的食谱，
并期待你有一天能做出
这样的食物。
送这份食物的人
也亲自烹饪了它。
请尝尝看...^000000

scripts.text:
^333333 Hopefully, you'll be
able to understand Sir 
Charles a little better 
after tasting this food.
 
 Your friend, Madeleine^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333希望你在品尝了
这些食物后，
能更理解查尔斯爵士一些。

你的朋友，玛德琳^000000

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Now I get it...
These are the recipes
that Sir Charles tried
to teach me. But I refused
to learn them because I had
thought they were too gross...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
原来如此...
这些就是查尔斯爵士
试图教我的食谱。
但我当时拒绝了，
因为我觉得它们太恶心了...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
......
.........
It's so delicious... Are
you sure you're just a
beginner? No... This must
be what I've been missing...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
......
.........
真好吃...
你确定你只是个初学者吗？
不...这一定是我
一直缺失的东西...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
It's what my master
always tried to teach me,
but I was too impatient to
properly learn it. The greatest
ingredient of them all... ^D02090heart^000000. After all this time, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
这就是我的师父
一直试图教给我的，
但我当时太急躁，
没能好好学会。
最重要的食材...
^D02090心^000000。
过了这么久，我终于明白了。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Thank you for bringing
this food to me. I will enjoy
it thoroughly, and reflect upon
what my old teacher was trying
to tell me. In return, please have one of my humble Rice Cakes.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
谢谢你把这些食物带给我。
我会好好享用，
并反思我的老师
想告诉我的道理。
作为回报，
请尝尝我做的Q弹的长条糕。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
I better visit Prontera
again soon. It's been a long
time since I've seen Madeleine.
More importantly, I think that
I should apologize to Sir Charles.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
我最好尽快再去一趟普隆德拉。
好久没见玛德琳了。
更重要的是，
我觉得我应该向查尔斯爵士道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
I don't have it!
Where did I put
that Bundle of Food?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等...
我没带！
我把那个食物保鲜袋
放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
Lately, it seems that
no one wants to buy my
Rice Cakes. It's been like
that ever since I left Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
最近，似乎没人
愿意买我的Q弹的长条糕了。
自从我离开普隆德拉以来
一直如此...

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
You see, I used to study
in that city as one of Sir
Charles's apprentices. It
was only a few months, but
I was very excited to get the
chance to learn under him.
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
你看，我曾经
在那座城市学习，
是查尔斯爵士的学徒之一。
虽然只有几个月，
但我当时非常兴奋，
能有机会在他门下学习。

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
At least, I was excited
at first. Sir Charles really
frustrated me: he would
only teach me to make these
really gross sounding recipes! Like Grasshopper Legs and-- ugh!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
至少，一开始我很兴奋。
查尔斯爵士真让我沮丧：
他只教我做那些
听起来很恶心的食谱！
比如蚱蜢腿，还有-- 唉！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
He kept insisting that
I was forgetting the most
important ingredient, and that
it was possible to make things
like Fried Monkey Tails delicious. But I can't believe that nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
他坚持认为我
忘记了最重要的食材，
并且认为像热炒猴尾巴
这样的东西也能做得美味。
但我无法相信这种胡话！

scripts.text:
[Chulsoo]
In the end, I ran away.
For some reason, I feel
a little ashamed and regret
what I did. Still, I don't see
what Sir Charles meant...
scripts.translation:
[哲秀]
最后，我逃跑了。
不知为何，我现在
感到有点羞愧和后悔。
但我还是不明白
查尔斯爵士的意思...
